description: This file defines the 'ConnectionStatus' class, which manages and monitors the connection state within the software system. It includes logic for reacting to time, sensor updates, and message events to update connection status, and provides methods for external components to listen for status changes.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus
classes.description: Manages the connection status, listening to engine time, sensor updates, and message events to determine and broadcast connection state changes. Implements singleton pattern and supports listener registration.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Value
classes.description: Enumeration representing possible connection states: NOT_CONNECTED, LOADING, CONNECTED.

classes.name: ConnectionStatus.Listener
classes.description: Interface for components that want to receive connection status change notifications.

methods.name: executeOnceConnected
methods.description: Runs a provided Runnable when the system is detected as connected.

methods.name: markConnected
methods.description: Transitions the connection state to LOADING and restarts the timer to monitor connection activity.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the connection status value and notifies all registered listeners.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns true if the system is considered connected.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the current connection status value.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a new listener for connection status changes.
